materials: cGAS Enzymatic Assay – cGAMP Fluorescence Polarization Format

PF-06928215 was synthesized in house according to procedures in the Methods section; PF-06928215 is commercially available via Sigma-Aldrich (catalog number PZ038). ISD DNA (catalog number tlrl-isdn), ATP, GTP, cAMP, cGMP, cGAMP were purchased from Invivogen, Donkey anti mouse-IgG-HRP from Jackson ImmunoResearch, BD OptEIA Substrate Reagent Set Cy5 mono NHS ester from GE Healthcare Life Sciences, N,N-diisopropylethylamine from Applied Biosystems, N-methyl-2-pyrrolidone from Applied Biosystems, trifluoroacetic acid (TFA) from Applied Biosystems and acetonitrile (HPLC grade) from Fisher Scientific. PPD was purchased from Cambridge Research Biomolecules, BSA from Thermo Fisher Scientific, Streptavidin from Thermo Fisher Scientific, sodium bicarbonate from Sigma-Aldrich, dimethyl sulfoxide from Sigma-Aldrich and Slide-A-lyzer cassettes from Thermo Fisher Scientific.

cGAS production: Vector Construction. Amino acids 2-522 of human MB21D1 (Uniprot ID: Q8N884; codon optimized for Spodoptera frugiperda) was synthesized at GeneArt AG (LifeTechnologies/Thermo-Fisher) and sub-cloned to the baculovirus transfer vector pFastBac1 via BamHI and EcoRI restriction sites. A 6X HIS tag and TEV protease cleavage site (MGSSHHHHHHENLYFQG) were added to the 5’ end of the insert sequence. Recombinant bacmid was generated according to the manufacturer’s instructions, and successful transposition was confirmed by PCR.

cGAS expression. Spodoptera frugiperda (Sf-9) cells were cultured in SF-900-III SFM medium (Invitrogen #12658-027) in Corning 3 L baffled flasks (#431253, polycarbonate, vented cap) at 65 rpm, on a Lab Companion shaker (SKC6200, 2 inch orbit) incubated a 27o C in a Thermo Scientific Incubator (Model #3940).

A 1ml aliquot of BIIC1 [baculovirus infected insect cells preserved at 1x107 vc/ml in freezing medium: 90% (v/v) SF-900-III SFM supplemented with 10gl-1 (w/v) bovine serum albumin (Sigma-Aldrich) and 10% (v/v) DMSO (Sigma-Aldrich)] was removed from -80 oC preservation, rapidly thawed and diluted 1 to 100 in SF-900-III media. One liter of log phase Sf-9 cells at a cell density of 1.75 x106 cells/mL and >95% viability were infected with 5 ml per liter of BIIC suspension per 1x106 viable cells/ml. Cell density, cell viability and cell diameter were determined daily using a ViCell analyzer (Beckman Coulter). The cells were harvested at 72 hours post infection when cell viability dropped to 77-83% and cell diameter increased ~2.75-3.3 m. The resulting cell paste was collected by refrigerated centrifugation at 3,500g, aliquotted, flash frozen in liquid nitrogen and stored at -80 oC.

cGAS Purification. The purification protocol was based on Kranzusch et al.2 with modifications. Briefly, cells (~50 g) were lysed in buffer A (20 mM Hepes pH 7.5, 400 mM NaCl, 10% Glycerol, 1 mM TCEP) with benzonase (Sigma), using a microfluidizer with 3 passes at 18K psi. The solution was clarified by centrifugation at 10,000 g for 30 min. The supernatant was applied to 5 x 5 ml HisTrap FF crude columns in tandem pre-equilibrated in Buffer A. The column was washed with buffer A with 50 mM imidazole, buffer A with 1 M NaCl, and then eluted with buffer A with 300 mM imidazole.
All procedures were conducted at 4 o C. All buffers contained 1X ROCHE COMPLETETM proteinase inhibitors EDTA-free and benzamidine. The final storage buffer did not contain benzamidine.

cGAMP mAb. Antibodies against cGAMP were generated by immunizing 8 week old A/J mice and SJL/J mice (The Jackson Laboratory) with a 2:1 mixture of the cGAMP compounds linked at the adenine NH2, PPD-cGAMP and Streptavidin-cGAMP, and Complete Freud’s Adjuvant, subcutaneously, for the first immunization only. The mice were subsequently boosted three more times as above, except with Incomplete Freund’s Adjuvant, spaced every three weeks. Mouse sera titers were determined by screening for binding to cGAMP-BSA derivatives coated on a plate in a DELFIA immunoassay (Perkin Elmer). Once a high titer was detected the mouse selected for fusion was given an intraperitoneal final boost with a 2:1 mixture of the two cGAMP analogues above, no adjuvant, four days prior to the fusion. Hybridomas were derived by a fusion of mouse splenocytes from a high titer mouse with the mouse myeloma cell NS-1 (ATCC). Mouse spleen cells were isolated, the red blood cells were lysed in Red Blood Cell lysing buffer (Sigma), and the splenocytes were depleted of B cells expressing surface IgM by using magnetically labeled anti-mouse IgM micro beads (MAC Miltenyl Biotec). The cells were washed twice in IMDM media (Gibco) and pelleted with the NS-1 cells at a 4:1 ratio. A solution of 50% PEG (Sigma) was added to the pellet with gentle shaking. The cells were plated in 96 well plates in IMDM media containing HAT for one week before the hybridomas were screened.

steps.title: Purify cGAS via Heparin and SEC
steps.instruction: Pool the His‑Trap eluate fractions, dilute 1:1 with Buffer C (20 mM Hepes pH 7.5, 10 % glycerol, 1 mM TCEP); load half of this diluted eluate onto two 5 mL Heparin columns pre‑equilibrated with Buffer C, wash with Buffer C containing 500 mM NaCl, and elute with a linear gradient from 500 mM to 1 M NaCl, collecting two peaks (Fraction #1 and Fraction #2). Repeat the Heparin step with the remaining half of the His‑Trap eluate. Combine all Fraction #1 pools and all Fraction #2 pools separately. Load each combined pool onto a Superdex 200 26/60 column equilibrated in 20 mM Hepes pH 7.5, 250 mM KCl, 1 mM TCEP, 10 % glycerol; combine the SEC fractions, concentrate to 1 mg mL⁻¹, aliquot, and flash‑freeze in liquid nitrogen. Use Fraction #2 for downstream assays, retaining the His‑tag.

substeps.instruction: Pool and dilute His‑Trap eluate 1:1 with Buffer C.
Load half onto two 5 mL Heparin columns (pre‑equilibrated with Buffer C).
Wash with Buffer C + 500 mM NaCl.
Elute with 500 mM → 1 M NaCl gradient; collect Fraction #1 and #2.
Repeat Heparin chromatography with the second half of eluate.
Combine all Fraction #1 pools; combine all Fraction #2 pools.
Load each combined pool onto Superdex 200 26/60 equilibrated in 20 mM Hepes pH 7.5, 250 mM KCl, 1 mM TCEP, 10 % glycerol.
Combine SEC fractions, concentrate to 1 mg mL⁻¹, aliquot, flash‑freeze.
Store Fraction #2 for cGAS assays; keep His‑tag attached.

steps.title: Produce and Purify cGAMP Antibody
steps.instruction: Screen hybridoma supernatants for binding to BSA‑cGAMP derivatives by DELFIA; confirm specificity over cAMP and cGMP using biotin‑cAMP and biotin‑cGMP (Biotium) on streptavidin plates (Pierce). Clone specific hybridomas once by limiting dilution, expand them in IMDM medium containing low‑IgG fetal bovine serum (Hyclone). Purify antibodies from conditioned media by protein A/G chromatography followed by size‑exclusion chromatography, concentrate to ~5 mg mL⁻¹, dialyze against 20 mM HEPES, 150 mM NaCl, pH 7, and assess monomer content, purity, concentration, and stability after one freeze‑thaw cycle.

substeps.instruction: Screen hybridoma supernatants with DELFIA using BSA‑cGAMP.
Test specificity using biotin‑cAMP and biotin‑cGMP on streptavidin plates.
Clone positive hybridomas by limiting dilution (single round) and expand.
Culture hybridomas in IMDM with low‑IgG FBS (Hyclone).
Purify antibodies from conditioned media via protein A/G chromatography.
Perform size‑exclusion chromatography on the eluate.
Concentrate purified antibody to ~5 mg mL⁻¹.
Dialyze against 20 mM HEPES, 150 mM NaCl, pH 7.
Analyze for monomer percentage, purity, concentration, and freeze‑thaw stability.

steps.title: Perform cGAMP ELISA
steps.instruction: Coat Costar high‑binding plates with 50 ng well⁻¹ BSA‑cGAMP in calcium‑/magnesium‑free PBS and incubate overnight at 4 °C. Wash plates with TBS + 0.05 % Tween‑20, block for 2 h at room temperature with assay buffer (TBS + 0.05 % Tween‑20 + 1 % BSA), then wash. Add cGAMP monoclonal antibody diluted in assay buffer and incubate 1 h, wash, add donkey anti‑mouse IgG‑HRP and incubate another hour. After a final wash, develop with substrate, stop the reaction with 2 N H₂SO₄, and read absorbance at 450 nm.

substeps.instruction: Coat plates with 50 ng/well BSA‑cGAMP in PBS (no Ca²⁺/Mg²⁺); incubate overnight at 4 °C.
Wash with TBS + 0.05 % Tween‑20.
Block 2 h at RT with TBS + 0.05 % Tween‑20 + 1 % BSA.
Wash plates.
Add cGAMP mAb (diluted in assay buffer); incubate 1 h at RT.
Wash plates.
Add donkey anti‑mouse IgG‑HRP; incubate 1 h at RT.
Wash plates.
Develop with appropriate substrate.
Stop reaction with 2 N H₂SO₄.
Measure OD at 450 nm.

steps.title: Run Competition ELISA (optional)
steps.instruction: Prepare the same ELISA plates as above, but pre‑incubate 40 ng mL⁻¹ anti‑cGAMP mAb with varying concentrations of cGAMP, ATP, or GTP for 1 h before adding to the coated wells. After the 1 h incubation on the plate, wash, add secondary antibody, develop, and read as described for the standard ELISA.

substeps.instruction: Mix 40 ng mL⁻¹ anti‑cGAMP mAb with test concentrations of cGAMP, ATP, or GTP; incubate 1 h at RT.
Add the pre‑incubated mixture to BSA‑cGAMP‑coated plates; incubate 1 h at RT.
Wash plates.
Add donkey anti‑mouse IgG‑HRP; incubate 1 h at RT.
Wash plates.
Develop, stop with 2 N H₂SO₄, and read OD450.

steps.title: Execute Cy5‑cGAMP Fluorescence Polarization Assay
steps.instruction: Prepare reaction buffer (10 mM Hepes, 140 mM NaCl, 0.01 % Tween‑20, 5 mM MgCl₂, pH 7.5) containing 1 mM ATP, 0.3 mM GTP, 100 nM ISD DNA (45 bp dsDNA), and 100 nM cGAS. Add test compounds for inhibition studies if desired. Incubate 1 h at room temperature, then stop reactions with 50 mM EDTA. Add 2 nM Cy5‑cGAMP and 16 nM cGAMP antibody, incubate another hour at room temperature, and read fluorescence polarization on an Envision plate reader (excitation 620 nm, emission 688 nm).

substeps.instruction: Prepare assay buffer: 10 mM Hepes, 140 mM NaCl, 0.01 % Tween‑20, 5 mM MgCl₂, pH 7.5.
Add 1 mM ATP, 0.3 mM GTP, 100 nM ISD DNA (45 bp), and 100 nM cGAS.
Include test compounds for inhibition assays if required.
Incubate 1 h at RT.
Stop reactions with 50 mM EDTA.
Add 2 nM Cy5‑cGAMP and 16 nM cGAMP antibody.
Incubate 1 h at RT.
Measure fluorescence polarization (excitation 620 nm, emission 688 nm) using an Envision plate reader.
